name: Baseline Measurement

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

primaryTarget: native macOS (Metal) through benchmark/run.py --target macos; web, Android and iOS are out of scope for this loop
hypothesisMarkdown:
## Baseline Measurement

Measure and document the starting point for this improvement loop before making optimization changes.
measurementPlanMarkdown:
### Measurement Plan

`python3 benchmark/run.py --target macos --reps 3 --name agentx-baseline` (all 15 scenarios, fast mode off and on, 600 measured frames after 120 warm-up). Work counters: `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=benchmark/target-stats cargo build --release --features fast-stats`, then `gpux-bench --scenario <id> --fast on --frames 300`. Profiles: macOS `sample` on the running benchmark (main thread inclusive tree).

reportMarkdown:
## Baseline Measurement Finished

Fast mode on beats off on 10 of 15 scenarios on macOS; one loss (text-log-stream +3.5% CPU, draw p95 +10%), tree-toggle p95 +34%, scroll-data-table p95 +10% with 5 missed frames. Memory: scroll scenarios +31..49% footprint, heap peak up to +96%.

### Ranked candidate backlog
1. `StretchCopy::prepaint` copies (dashboard-clock, text-typing, table-stream): primitives_copied 1,966/frame; memmove and per-node devtools copies dominate draw. Mechanism: cheaper copy of unchanged stretches (devtools node footprint, bulk copy).
2. Frame-end work: `edge_shadows::dropped` and `DevtoolsFrameNode` drop each frame (about 14% of draw in the clock).
3. scroll-div-cards: layout/prepaint walk of 6,800 nodes inside a composited layer on scroll-only frames.
4. scroll-data-table: list layer keeps/re-lays out rows (style writes 91/frame, nodes lingering 361/frame) and its memory (tiles, kept rows).
5. Layout retention that reuses nothing (tree-toggle, text-log-stream, text-relabel, hover-grid): adaptive per-view policy.
6. hover-grid: one hover repaints 11k primitives.
7. text-relabel: 1,190 shaped lines per frame; shaping cache for short numeric strings.
8. Allocations in scroll frames: pool layer bookkeeping.

Already fine: effects-cards (2.2 ms), scroll-variable-list (1.6 ms), animated-dots.

### Scope Lock
Tested mechanism: measurement only. Out-of-scope changes: none. Attempt Count: 1.
decisionMarkdown:
### Decision

Baseline recorded. Work through the backlog one mechanism at a time, each measured with benchmark/run.py --target macos on the affected scenarios (3 reps).
